steps: Rinse the rice and moong dal together three times, soak them in water for 20 minutes, then drain.
Heat most of the ghee in a pressure cooker on medium, add the cumin, and when it sizzles add the hing.
Add the chopped onion and cook on medium for 2 to 3 minutes, until soft and see-through.
Add the tomato, ginger, green chilli and turmeric and cook for 3 to 4 minutes, until the tomato softens.
Add the drained rice and dal and stir for a minute.
Pour in about 400 ml water a person and add the salt; the water should taste slightly salty.
Close the cooker, cook on medium for 4 to 5 whistles, then let the pressure drop on its own.
Stir well, add hot water and simmer for a minute if it is too thick, and serve hot with the rest of the ghee on top.
note: Two recipes used half a cup each of rice and dal for two people and one stretched it to three; this keeps 50 g of each a person, since khichdi is the whole meal. Ghee includes a spoon to drizzle on top.
